say: When you throw four heads at one spot, the four bodies merge into one.
The first version picked a leader, and everyone else snapped to its position, its facing and its step.
The leader was whoever came first in the list, so the merge always leaned toward that runner.
Now the crew meets in the middle, at the average position, the average step and the average facing.
Angles need care. Three hundred and fifty degrees and ten degrees should average to north, but adding them and dividing by two gives a hundred and eighty, which is south.
sub: Angles need care. 350° and 10° should average to north, but adding them and dividing by two gives 180°, which is south.

say: So each angle becomes an arrow on a circle, the arrows are added together, and their sum points the right way.
The walk cycle is an angle too, so the merged runner lands in step.
